crossRefs.note: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we…
For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

translations.web: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
translations.bsb: She sees that her gain is good, and her lamp is not extinguished at night.
translations.kjv: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
translations.asv: She perceiveth that her merchandise is profitable: Her lamp goeth not out by night.
